title: John Mack and Terence McKenna on the Western paradigm bursting open

tellings.quote: John Max says oh it's gonna it's G to burst open and we're all going to realize that the Western Paradigm is incredibly myopic and closed

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, recalls an idea from the 1990s linked to John Mack, a Harvard psychiatrist who studied people who said they had been taken by aliens, and Terence McKenna, a writer on psychedelics and the mind. As Michels tells it, Mack predicted that the Western paradigm, meaning the shared set of assumptions about what is real, would "burst open" and that we would all see how narrow and closed it had been. Michels ties this to Thomas Kuhn, a historian of science known for writing about how such paradigms get overturned, because if Mack is right, our whole picture of reality would have to change.
